Dictation fills the last text box you tapped. Commands navigate, e.g. “go to inventory”, “status report”, “catering log”. Always review voice‑entered text before saving.

Note: microphones only work when the app is opened over https:// (or localhost) — not from a downloaded file. Host it (e.g. Netlify Drop) to enable voice. Works best in Chrome/Edge/Android; limited on iPhone/Safari.
